renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Consciousness itself is you. Knowing little things traps you. Your deep wishes live in a womb; your knowing lives in the Mother sound. A surge — that is the Lord. When power joins, the world pulls back. Knowing is being awake.
